Screws: 24 rays on the D4.5 circle + rings r 2.0 / 1.5 / 1.0 + axis from the head top along the tool direction for 150 mm; 'own_recess_only' = the only obstacle is the screw's own counterbore in the part it clamps (hex key / bit instead of the D4.5 shaft).
